objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-impair-defense-delete-win-defender-context-menu
objects.description: The following analytic detects the deletion of the Windows Defender context menu entry from the registry. It leverages data from the Endpoint datamodel, specifically monitoring registry actions where the path includes "*\\shellex\\ContextMenuHandlers\\EPP" and the action is 'deleted'. This activity is significant as it is commonly associated with Remote Access Trojan (RAT) malware attempting to disable security features.
